name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park, CA) Dulce de Leche "Besito" Butter Shortbread Cookie
whyItWorks: Tender, melt-in-your-mouth butter shortbread cookie filled with rich, caramelized dulce de leche and dusted with powdered sugar. Completely seed-free and nut-free.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a box of Besito cookies for snacking at Knott's Berry Farm.
